dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Only rest when you're tired? Ugh... Typical adult nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: By the same reasoning, we should wait until we're about to faint from hunger before eating, or die of thirst before drinking. It really is best not to listen to anything they say.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: I've read genuine medical studies on this. Preventative rest is far more effective than corrective recovery.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hmph! That Imaginarium Theater... It's clearly the work of a witch!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: But that suits me just fine! I'll treat this as a dress rehearsal — a chance to refine my "Witchhunter Training Program."

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: This is a personal grudge between me and that witch. I absolutely will not accept defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Alice, I know you can hear me! I know you're spying on me from somewhere!

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Unwilling to show yourself, huh? Is it 'cause you're scared? Or perhaps you can see you're wrong because of all the righteous allies by my side? You finally feel ashamed of everything you've done, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Prune
dialogues.text: Hah! Keep hiding and I'll... I'll... I'll come back tomorrow! Don't you forget, I'm not done with you yet!
